description: This file defines authentication API endpoints for user registration and login using FastAPI. It includes route handlers, dependency injection for database session, and security functions for password hashing and token generation.

methods.name: Token register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user in the database, and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: Token login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Handles user login, verifies credentials, and returns a JWT token.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep)) -> Token:$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^def register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep)) -> Token:$/
